on inferno: 1 anti-eco (R8), 1 anti-half-buy (R19)

on mirage: 1 anti-half-buy (R3)


That's why NIP lost
Losing anti-ecos has been a known issue for NIP since August, and they have to fix it in order to go further.

text.text:
Losing an anti-eco/anti-half-buy is not necessarily a big deal at the beginning of the first-half of a map, unless you played badly. You still have rounds to build it back and come back. ImpV managed to do that on Mirage after the anti-half-buy loss.

I think Dust2 round 13 (the face of Vilga during the timeout after that speaks for itself) + the anti-eco loss on the same map round 22 cost NIP the victory.

It should be interesting to count every anti-eco lost by NIP since August. I don't know if HLTV provides relevant data for that.

This also revealed the difference of experience between those two teams in very important moments. ImpV are used to get in tricky situations, and they are very good at punishing mistakes, as they did to NIP.

I was afraid NIP collapsed in the Dust2 second half. Maybe they suffered from the Supernova Comets effect ;-).

text.text:
i think losing anti-ecos is more deadly for NIP than imperial because NIP rarely win a round very cleanly.
Often they fail to accumulate a healthy economy even if coming out of a win streak

hltv do provide the available data. they have the economy of every round in the stats section. but you have to count them all yourselves.
i once counted NIP's lost anti-ecos in some of their close matches, like vs Heroic Academy and vs ex-8sins (square sausages)
and indeed, nip would have won against both teams, or at least go into map 3 if they were not losing more anti-ecos than their opponents.
in all these games, they lose 1 or 2 anti-ecos/half-buys per map

the results also show why NIP and Imperial are, imo, currently, the only teams that can challenge male teams
eu salaried male teams usually have very good details.
only nip and imperial have a similar level of good details that punishes their opponents when they are not careful
and nip is not as good as imperial in this regard. their insane firepower often bails them out if their mistakes (crispy kills from the twins and clutches from zana and aim)

and i do believe mentality plays a role. i knew how bad they must have felt from the cameras
imagine losing 11:13 on map 2 and then making mistakes on the decider
i hope they grow a strong mindset as they grow stronger in the mechanics
